triage.summary: A sender claiming to be DHL says parcel 7781-2290 is on hold for an unpaid $2.99 customs fee and demands payment within 24 hours to avoid its return.
triage.risk_reason: The message impersonates DHL using the suspicious domain dhl-parcel-track.info and pressures the recipient to pay through its link within 24 hours.
